order: Correct the Quartermaster's default review-draw forecast under ruling R4. The prior derivation sustained the peak arrival rate for a week, setting the mandatory review draw above anything observed and pushing the default required reserve past the Green threshold, so the reserve gate fired on nearly any bucket. Because that fabricates load, replace the default with the measured weekly draw of 0.03, leave the incident draw at zero as a disclosed under-estimate, and keep the rejected peak-derived arithmetic in the comments as the cautionary alternative. The resulting dynamic term sits below the eight-percent floor, so the floor governs. Touch only defaultForecast() and the comment block documenting that ruling, the README section recording it, and the pinned test values, adding a check that the floor rather than the dynamic term governs. Every other behaviour of the seat must survive unchanged — the override path, the freshness rules, the fail-closed refusals, the confirmation handshake, the throttle-prediction method and the report output.
claims: defaultForecast() now returns the measured weekly draw, and the rejected peak-derived arithmetic is preserved in the comments as the cautionary alternative, computed but unused. The README section records both derivations and notes the override path is unaffected. The pinned values follow the measured draw and the floor, with an explicit check that the floor, not the dynamic term, governs the default. Both suites are green — node tests/quartermaster.test.js reports 154 passed and node tests/router.test.js reports 135 passed.
